name: Princess Anna
source:
Ashe's little sister, Princess of Great Breton.
A shy girl, she loves her older brother.
She always wanted to have a sisterly relationship and adores the protagonist as an older sister.
She has a bit of a crush on her cousin Elias.
[spoiler]She has an individual ending[/spoiler]
